                MIN(bat) AS batter,
                MIN(bowl) AS bowler,

                SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls,
                SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRY_CAST(wide AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(noball AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls,
                SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN TRY_CAST(batruns AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS runs,
                SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 AND LOWER(CAST(out AS VARCHAR)) = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals,
                SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(CAST(dismissal AS VARCHAR)) IN ('caught', 'bowled', 'leg before wicket', 'stumped', 'hit wicket', 'caught and bowled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
                SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(batruns AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dot_balls,
                SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRY_CAST(wide AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(noball AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(bowlruns AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bowler_dot_balls,

              balls,
              legal_balls,
              runs,
              dismissals,
              wickets,
              dot_balls,
              bowler_dot_balls,
